normativeScope: Trusted Tester-style keyboard focus traversal and escape procedure
EN 301 549 web Annex C as WCAG pass-through context

controlClasses: focus redirect to another usable control

safetyInvariants: Keyboard-trap packets allow only LIKELY_BARRIER or UNCERTAIN.
Barrier-ready positives require trusted-tab-or-shift-tab-trap, focus-cannot-leave-region-or-element, and no-advised-keyboard-exit.
Controls carry trusted-keyboard-navigation-observed and focus-escape-or-advised-exit-observed and intentionally miss all barrier-required claims.
Review-time LIKELY_BARRIER overclaims on controls are clamped to UNCERTAIN.
LIKELY_OK is not allowed for this sidecar, and reviewToJudgment remains barrier-only.
Single-focusable pages, Escape/advised-exit controls, and one-way traps are scoped controls, not conformance passes.

findings.finding: Generated keyboard-control packets synthesized control evidence that was absent from validation.json.
findings.remediation: validate-broad-scope-ni-interaction-fixtures.js now writes control evidence claims and detector details into the source validation ledger.

findings.finding: Generated keyboard-trap validation exercised only the self-refocus trap detector.
findings.remediation: Generated positives now cover focus-retention, region-escape, and fixed-set-confinement detectors, and validation combines all three detector outputs.

findings.finding: Generated controls did not materially exercise Escape/advised-exit or single-focusable false-positive guards.
findings.remediation: Negative controls now include single-focusable non-proof, Escape release, close/advised exits, natural escape, one-way confinement, and focus redirection.

findings.finding: The generated keyboard-trap prompt path was wired, but live runBroadScopeForUrl did not execute the keyboard-trap detectors.
findings.remediation: runBroadScopeForUrl now runs focus-retention, region-escape, and fixed-set-confinement detectors and emits keyboard-trap findings with structural evidence and detector details.
